text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bweh! I lost~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Still!
Totally hyped up!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
These feelings...!
I absolutely... have to convey them!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ruby!!

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Daiichi Ruby... You may not have achieved
a three-generation sweep, but that was a magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Um, so in the case of sprint distances,
what sort of race will you be moving on to next?

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I think... I might take a break from cheering.
I'm not prepared to watch
Ruby-sama's decline any longer...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Pathetic.
Utterly—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady!
Milaaadyyy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That was super fun, like what the heck!?
My crush-power is too insane-o!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Well, we both lost, but hey! There's always next time anyway☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, you can still run, right?
Huh? Hey hey?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I must retrain myself from the ground up.
So that I will never lose to "anyone" ever again.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have learned much from your running as well.
...Now, if you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...To nobody?
Yourself??"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Doesn't something feel totally off!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, I lost!
I lost, sure, but! It was a great match, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Have you ever seen Ojo like this before?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From what I've heard, Daiichi Ruby is pushing herself
immensely. A half-hearted run might not even register to her..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Boring!!
I can't get hyped if Milady isn't watching!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And nobody even laughed at all!!
Boo-oo-or-ing~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Uhya!?
choice_data_list: That's Totally Lacking Hype, Isn't It!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me?
You're really trying to rile me up, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No, no,
I'm a hardcore party animal, alright?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Morning hype? Nah, at this point
it's way past morning, it's dinner time!!
choice_data_list: Then let's level up our party game even more!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If I do that, young lady,
will ya totally stan me!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"By the time I clash with Daiichi Ruby again, I'll become an overwhelming presence.
To hone my party-people vibe, I'll aim for the prelude to the Yasuda Kinen, which she'll surely target too――"
choice_data_list: Let's bring the hype at the Milers Cup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the next target race was decided: the Yomiuri Milers Cup.
